rule: Every zero, negative, or empty slot is one punishment. Serve it or it carries.
_howto: Add entries to the log list above. Each one looks like this:
manager:    Sleeper username. Survives team name changes, so prefer it
over 'team'. The Log a punishment form on the site fills
count:      how many offenses this settles. Defaults to 1.
proof:      optional link to a photo or video
Commas go BETWEEN entries, never after the last one -- that is the one
thing that breaks the file. If the JSON is invalid the build still runs,
it just skips the ledger and prints a warning in the Actions log.
